blocker_policy.unknown_identity_or_abi: REFUSE; do not infer support from model names or CANN major versions
blocker_policy.failed_native_attempt: Retain the original receipt; permit at most three bounded, diagnosed attempts
blocker_policy.no_effect: Retain NO_DIFFERENCE; never manufacture a calibration or lower the statistics tolerance
blocker_policy.recovery_uncertain: Do not release an unsafe owner or report recovery; retain pending resources and escalate
blocker_policy.scope: CPU, constructed replay, pretrained model and public Worker evidence are not interchangeable
blocker_policy.statistics: Preserve null, nonfinite, alignment failure and downstream-only observations

controller_delegation.reason: Explicit root delegation of natural QMM projection boundary and minimal dispatch changes
